title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
描述评分指标或评测协议

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On 120 template-related requests, the full workflow achieves 98.3% correct first-turn specification and decision outcomes, compared with 92.5% for schema-assisted single shot and 82.5% for model-only: gains of 5.8 and 15.8 percentage points, respectively.
